#Notes
Steps :
1. Always first connect to the database then start server or listen to the app. (IMP)
2. Create schema - (schema is a identity for documents)(DOCS LINK :https://mongoosejs.com/docs/guide.html)
3. About Schema :
=>In Mongoose, a schema is a blueprint or structure for a MongoDB document. 
=>It defines the shape and structure of the documents within a MongoDB collection, specifying the fields, their data types, and any constraints or validation rules.
=>A schema in Mongoose is created using the mongoose.Schema class.
